source_title: HBTU Kanpur Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 25 Professor, Associate Professor & Other Posts (Regular)
source_excerpt:
Vacancies: 25 (indicative) · Posts: 16 designation(s) · Type: State University · Regular · Mode: Online · Fee: Not mentioned · Apply: By 08 December 2026 · Salary: Not specified in the notification · Selection: Screening and shortlisting + Interview (details on website) · Location: Kanpur, UP
Harcourt Butler Technical University (HBTU), Kanpur, has invited online applications for direct recruitment to 25 regular faculty and administrative positions. The notice (File No. 1460/HBTU/Estt/01/2026 dated 24 October 2026) covers Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor and one Assistant Workshop Superintendent post across engineering, technology and humanities departments.
HBTU Kanpur Faculty Bharti 2026 covers 25 posts in Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh. Associate Professor holds the largest share (11 seats). Some posts are marked to become vacant later in 2026–27.
Eligible candidates apply online only through the HBTU Kanpur website by 08 December 2026 (Tuesday) till 11:59 pm. Detailed procedure, General Instructions & Information, Recruitment Rules, Screening and Shortlisting criteria and tentative schedule are available on the university website.
⚠️ Application Alerts: check these before you submit the form.
The number of posts is indicative; the university may not fill any post or may decrease/increase the numbers.
All relevant documents must be uploaded with the online application form only; no separate hard copy is mentioned.
Four posts (or parts) become vacant only on later dates (01 December 2026, 01 January 2027, 01 March 2027, 01 August 2027).
Correspondence only to recruitment2026@hbtu.ac.in .
